neighbours.label: The verb in 'to see if/whether', 'to try to' purpose frames (testing or attempting an outcome)
fire: We ran the engine to see if the noise would return.
Volunteers gathered to try to rebuild the fence.
He pressed the button again to see whether anything happened.
She tapped the wall to see if it was hollow.
Teams are working to try to restore power by dusk.
Scientists measured the dose to see how cells responded.
I called twice to see if you were home.
They waited to see what the judge would say.
quiet: We ran the engine to charge the battery before dusk.
Volunteers gathered to rebuild the fence.
He pressed the button again and a light came on.
She tapped the wall and it sounded hollow.
Teams are working to restore power by dusk.
Scientists measured the dose and cells responded.
I called twice because you were home.
They waited while the judge made a decision.
